top3: F-0014 + F-0013 (major): the production path for the slip-out answer (GPU Newton + sliding Coulomb friction on curved faces under moment control) has passed no gate. Gate 1c (slip) ran on the old solver, gate 1d never leaves stick (15 % of the limit), and the only gate-2 pass (flexion) had zero facet contact force at every increment. The Newton line search, when exhausted, accepts a step with the rigid bodies reset to the old position and half-size convergence norms (newton.py:221-233).

F-0015 + F-0016 (major, designer exploits / cord safety): after a slip the friction force restarts from zero (same rule in FEBio penalty, so gate 4 cannot see it). The size scales with the contact-layer material (penalty ratio 79 between soft and hard PLCL): estimated up to ~0.74 mm spurious creep for a soft layer vs 0.009 mm for a hard one over the S9 protocol, against the 0.5 mm posterior limit. S9 measures only the cage-centre translation, so a 4.1 deg spin (about 0.5 mm at a corner) or soft posterior lobes pass while threatening the cord.

F-0011 + F-0012 (major / minor): I-001 is resolved; on the corrected reruns the flexion / extension twist is <= 1.1 / 0.4 N mm (was ~170). But e02 treats the curved faces as flat and drops the out-of-plane shear: its 'M2' is 7.5x below the h15 force ratio at low load and up to 44 % below in extension. The 'M3 <= mu safe for sure / M2 > mu slips for sure' bracket is unproven for curved faces. Axial rotation now carries the largest face twist (~1.1 N m).

summary_zh: 紅隊第二輪提出 10 項新發現（8 項重大、2 項輕微）。第一，I-001 已用數字確認解決：負荷曲線修正後，前屈與後伸時 cage 接觸面的扭轉只剩 1.1 與 0.4 牛頓毫米（修正前約 170），cage 網格是對稱的。但摩擦需求程式（e02）把彎曲的接觸面當成平面計算，低估了所需的摩擦，最多差 7.5 倍；目前扭轉最大的方向是軸向旋轉。第二，真正用來判斷 cage 會不會滑出的計算方式（GPU 牛頓法求解器加上真實摩擦），到現在還沒有通過任何一道驗證關卡；唯一通過的測試根本沒有用到接觸；求解器的線搜尋也有一個程式錯誤。第三，設計者可以鑽的漏洞有兩個：（一）摩擦在滑動之後會先歸零，因此會多算出假的滑移，而且這個量取決於接觸層的材料軟硬，軟材料最多可能多算約 0.74 毫米，往後滑移的上限是 0.5 毫米；（二）滑出判定只看 cage 的中心點，cage 原地轉 4 度、或後方的軟材料部分往脊髓方向移動，都不會被抓到。另外：植入規則允許的材料應變，超過模擬所用材料的彈性極限；分工規則有多處沒有落實，例如寫程式的人自己出考題並宣布通過、發現沒有回覆、第一輪的暫停判定被略過卻沒有紀錄；有些文件的說法超過實際證明；修正後的重跑資料沒有收進新專案的快照。本輪沒有放置測試用的假結果。
